th Seals {Stationary & Rotating} of Francis Turbine of 250 MW Nathpa Jhakri Hydroelec tric Power Station which includes transportation (to & fro) from site to the site of repair s (s), insurance, removal of hard coating, development of fixtures for repair of eroded Lower labyrinth Seals, welding, NDT, Machining/ Grinding on VTL, equipments, consuma bles, packing etc. as per Technical specification & approved quality assurance plan of SJ VN” enclosed at Annexure-B. 4.3 Specific templates of the profile geometry for in process checks for rebuilding/grinding/machini ng. 4.4 SJVN provide its facilities as per clause no. 7.0 of the technical Specifications “Facilities to be provided by SJVN Ltd. free of charges”. 4.5 Any other activity (ies) not mentioned above, but found necessary for rebuilding / reclamation of the Lower Labyrinth Seals shall also be carried out by the contractor as per the directions of EIC. 4.6 The test certificates of welding electrodes, welder’s qualification certificates, NDT tests / record s /dimensional measures, deviation etc. as per technical specifications / quality assurance plan ma y be reviewed during the stage inspection or during final inspection by the EIC/ representative of EI C or third-party inspection agency deputed by the EIC.
